data.description:
# Intake Brief — One Tank changes colour (AH-0MTVYBL2L0085G6G)

## Problem statement

In the Tanks gym scene (`GymEnemies` booted with `enemyKey: 'tank'` from the gym index), one Tank — always the first alive in row-major spawn order (top-left initially) — renders green at rest and snaps to orange while any player thruster key is held, reverting to green on release. This color change communicates nothing to the player and should not happen: every Tank should render the Tank body colour at all times, independent of player input.

## Users

- **Player / playtester** — sees a stable, readable formation where colour identifies enemy type (orange = Tank); a Tank that flickers green↔orange with thrust input is confusing and looks broken.
- **Developer** — needs enemy body colour to be owned solely by entity construction/config, with no per-frame coupling to player input state.

### Example user stories

- As a **player**, when I open the Tanks gym I see six orange Tanks; holding or releasing thrust never changes any Tank's colour, so I trust that colour means enemy type.
- As a **player**, when I destroy the discoloured top-left Tank, the next Tank does not inherit the wrong colour — every survivor stays Tank-orange.
- As a **developer**, I can assert in a headless test that Tank body colour is invariant across thrust-input frames and across destruction order.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1 — Stable Tank colour:** booting the Tanks gym shows all alive Tanks in the Tank body colour at rest; holding any thrust key (arrows or WASD, either control scheme) changes no enemy's rendered colour; releasing changes nothing.
- [ ] **AC2 — No first-alive special-casing:** destroying Tanks in any order (top-left first, then left-to-right along rows, or any other order) never produces a wrong-coloured survivor; the "moves to the next alive" behaviour is gone.
- [ ] **AC3 — Regression test:** a headless test boots `GymEnemies` with the tank seed, simulates thrust-input frames, asserts every alive entity keeps the expected body colour, destroys the first entity and repeats for the next alive one. Fails before the fix, passes after.
- [ ] **AC4 — All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.**
- [ ] **AC5 — Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.**

## Constraints

- **Engine/stack:** Phaser 4.2.1 + TypeScript, Vite, Vitest (existing stack).
- **No behaviour change beyond the colour fix:** hit/invulnerability/respawn logic, destruction audio ownership, formation drift, radial bursts, and the editor panel's live-apply semantics stay as they are.
- **Colour ownership:** entity body colour stays constructor/config-owned; the fix must remove the coupling, not paper over it with a per-frame repaint.
- **Scene lifecycle:** the fix must survive `GymEnemies` stop→restart reuse of the same scene instance (existing SHUTDOWN teardown pattern in `GymFormationScene`).

## Existing state

- There is no standalone `GymTank` scene anymore: the index "Tanks" entry routes to the shared `GymEnemies` scene with `{ enemyKey: 'tank' }` (`src/scenes/GymIndex.ts`, `src/utils/enemyGymDiscovery.ts`).
- Tank seed config is 6 tanks, `rect` formation, body colour `0xff6600` (`src/core/enemyConfig.ts` `DEFAULT_ENEMY_CONFIGS.tank`); entities are built via `createEnemyFromConfig` (`src/entities/enemyFactory.ts`), which passes `config.color` into the `Tank` constructor.
- `Tank._color` is `private readonly`, set only in the constructor, and `_drawBody()` runs only at construction (`src/entities/Tank.ts`). No `setTint`/`clearTint` calls exist anywhere in `src/`; no first-alive highlight code was found.
- Spawn order is row-major (`buildRectFormationOffsets`, 3 columns in `src/utils/formations.ts`), and `entities` array order is stable — consistent with the observed "top-left first, then next alive left-to-right" progression.
- The only runtime mutation of entity colour fields is `GymEnemies._applyLive()`, which writes `_color`/`_colorNumber`/`_size`/bullet tunings on **panel DOM input events only** — not on thrust input. Tank exposes all of those fields, so it is affected by panel edits like every other enemy.
- Player thruster flames use `thrustFlameColor 0xff8c00` / inner `0xffff00` (`src/core/config.ts`); the ship redraws its own `Graphics` per frame while flames animate (`Player.preUpdate` → `_redraw`). No code path was found linking player input state to any enemy's body graphics.
- `loadEnemyConfig()` merges any stored localStorage entry over the seed defaults — a stale stored tank config (e.g. a scout-green `0x00ff00` colour saved under the tank key) would persist silently across sessions.
- Panel DOM button colours (green `#2ecc71` Respawn, orange `#ff8c00` Save As, `src/style.css`) are plain-DOM and cannot repaint canvas Tank bodies; ruled out as the cause.

## Desired change

1. Reproduce headlessly and/or visually: boot `GymEnemies` with the tank seed, hold thrust, observe which entity (if any) reports/renders a non-Tank colour; confirm actual vs expected hex values.
2. Identify the root cause among the leading hypotheses (stale localStorage tank colour merged over seed defaults; per-frame graphics coupling between the player ship redraw and the first entity's body graphics; panel live-apply writing a wrong colour; other — investigate, do not assume).
3. Fix the root cause so Tank body colour is invariant across thrust input and destruction order; if a stale stored config is the cause, handle migration/invalidation so existing players recover without manual localStorage edits.
4. Add the AC3 regression test; keep the full suite green.

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/gym/GymEnemies.ts` — Tanks scene (editor panel, `_applyLive`, `_onRespawn`, `collectBullets` tank branch `tryFireRadialBurst`).
- `src/entities/enemyFactory.ts` — `createEnemyFromConfig` builds the Tank with `config.color`.
- `src/core/enemyConfig.ts` — tank seed (`color: 0xff6600`) + `loadEnemyConfig` localStorage merge (staleness hypothesis).
- `src/entities/Tank.ts` — `_color` readonly, `_drawBody` at construction only; no repaint path today.
- `src/entities/Player.ts` — thruster flame colours + per-frame `_redraw` (thrust-coupling hypothesis).
- `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts` — `tick()` loop, `setAimTarget`, entity ordering, `_handleCollisions`, SHUTDOWN teardown.
- `src/utils/formations.ts` — `buildRectFormationOffsets` row-major spawn order.
- `src/scenes/GymIndex.ts`, `src/utils/enemyGymDiscovery.ts` — "Tanks" index entry routing.
- `src/core/config.ts`, `src/core/constants.ts` — ship/flame colours (`0xff8c00`, `0x00ffff`, `0x00ff00` references for comparison).

**Key Files:**
- `src/scenes/gym/GymEnemies.ts` — Scene under test; panel live-apply writes entity colour fields on DOM input.
- `src/entities/enemyFactory.ts` — Builds Tank from config colour; verify the value reaching the constructor.
- `src/core/enemyConfig.ts` — Seed defaults + localStorage merge; check for stale stored tank colour.
- `src/entities/Tank.ts` — Body rendering; needs invariant-colour regression coverage.
- `src/entities/Player.ts` — Thruster input/flame path; rule out or confirm per-frame coupling.
- `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts` — Tick/collision ordering behind the first-alive progression.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk — root cause unconfirmed:** no code path found yet explains the symptom; the leading hypotheses (stale localStorage colour, per-frame graphics coupling) may both be wrong. Mitigation: AC3 forces a reproducer first; if headless repro fails, reproduce visually in-browser before fixing.
- **Risk — overlap with in-flight VFX work:** `AH-0MTV6ADT4001FB2V` (explosion VFX) touches the same per-entity colour area. Mitigation: coordinate merge order; keep this fix minimal and colour-ownership scoped.
- **Assumption — operator's colour report is literal:** "green" = `0x00ff00`, "orange" = `0xff6600`; implementer to verify actual rendered/stored hexes during repro.
- **Scope-creep guard:** editor-panel colour UX, per-enemy colour customization, and explosion-VFX tuning are out of scope; file as linked work items if desired.

## Related work

- `Add particle-based explosion VFX for enemy and player deaths (AH-0MTV6ADT4001FB2V)` — in-progress feature that tints explosion particles by entity base colour; touches the same colour-per-entity area, coordinate to avoid conflicts.
- `Player-enemy collision (AH-0MTV7JOLU006W8PT)` — has an uncommitted diff in its worktree touching `GymFormationScene._handleCollisions`; adjacent code, watch for overlap.
- `Rewrite GymTank gym scene on the core library (AH-0MTAN4T0I004H187)` — completed; history of the Tanks scene.
- `Create E3 Tank gym scene (AH-0MT99I2OC0014MNZ)` — completed; original scene.
- `Entity-centred explosion colour jitter (AH-0MTVID3I1001Y034)` — blocked; per-entity colour derivation.
- `Explosion particle test suite (AH-0MTVH6DQO0016CGJ)` — open; colour-centred assertions may overlap AC3.
- `Config-aware entity seam (AH-0MTF3FJL009T2QL)` — completed; the `_color`/`_size` live-patch seam used by `_applyLive`.

## Appendix: clarifying questions & answers

- Q1: "Which tank? Is it always the same tank (e.g., always position 0,0 or a specific slot), or does it vary?" — Answer (operator, 2026-09-11): "It starts with the one in the top left. If that is destroyed it moves to the next on the top row, then the next. If not top row left it changes to the bottom row and moves left to right as enemies are destroyed." Research: matches row-major spawn order (`buildRectFormationOffsets`, 3 cols) + stable `entities` array order; i.e. the first alive entity in spawn order.
- Q2: "What color does it change to? (e.g. thruster flame 0xff8c00, ship 0x00ffff?)" — Answer (operator, 2026-09-11): "green until thruster pressed then orange, then back to green when released." Research: green matches Scout-green `0x00ff00`, orange matches Tank-orange `0xff6600`; exact on-screen hexes unverified — implementer to confirm.
- Q3: "Timing — immediately on thrust, or delayed?" — Answer (operator, 2026-09-11): "immediately." Research: suggests a per-frame coupling rather than a timer/tween.
- Q4: "Which scene?" — Answer (operator, 2026-09-11): "Whatever scene is loaded when I click 'Tanks' from the index scene." Research: that is `GymEnemies` with `{ enemyKey: 'tank' }` (`GymIndex.ts` + `enemyGymDiscovery.ts`); no standalone `GymTank` exists.
- Q5: "Reproduction steps / screenshot?" — Answer (operator, 2026-09-11): "Load index, click Tanks, top left enemy is green, press thruster key (any) changes to orange, let go goes back to green, shoot it and the one to its right turns green and does the same." No screenshot provided. This is the AC1/AC2 repro.

## Related work (automated report)

*Populated by `/skill:find-related` at intake close (keywords: tank, colour, gym, thrusters, scene; repo matches: `README.md`, `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md`, `docs/Game Design Document.md`):*

- **Add player to each Enemy Gym scene (AH-0MTD0Z0Y7003T1NT)** — completed; put the keyboard-controlled Player ship into the Tanks scene, which is the precondition for the thrust/colour coupling reported here.
- **Validate full test suite and documentation consistency (AH-0MTBDB3240043TLA)** — completed; routine validation, no direct link.
- **Add ship deceleration when no inputs, with slider to control deceleration rate (AH-0MTAFH1ZF003EGDF)** — completed; player thrust/movement tuning, adjacent at most.

data.comment: Completed work pushed to dev, see commit f070b3b. Root cause: Tank._drawBody() called bodyGraphics.clear() after the constructor queued lineStyle(2.5, this._color, 1), wiping the style; the outer hexagon then reused Phaser's module-global leftover strokeTint (GraphicsWebGLRenderer), so the first-rendered tank's colour leaked from unrelated redraws (player thrust flames) and appeared to move to the next alive tank on destruction. Fix: re-apply lineStyle() after clear() in Tank._drawBody() (removed the redundant pre-clear call), matching Scout/Diver/Swarm. Tests added: src/entities/Tank.test.ts command-buffer stroke-style regression and src/scenes/gym/GymEnemies.test.ts AC3 scene test (boot tank seed, thrust frames, destroy first alive in spawn order, assert every alive tank keeps TANK_COLOR). Docs updated: README.md graphics-gotcha note and docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md §4.2 (colour-leak variant). Full suite green via the test skill.
